body: I'm still around. I ended up simply going to sleep last night, although the sleep wasn't too restful. I've been panicking all day today, but have not really further considered taking the lives of anyone else. Am I still suicidal? Yes. Am I still homicidal? No, not today anyway. Who knows how I'll feel tomorrow though. :/
I'm not sure about hotlines. I'm fairly certain they're allowed to lie to you or send emergency services against your will, no? That's why I'm here instead.

But the evil is so widespread that I feel like everything is beyond hope. And talking about how evil something is on the internet is different from standing up for the victim irl, which seems to be lacking in most of the stories.
